Sub: Audio Recording of Earnings Call held on 17th August, 2026. 
 
Ref: Regulation 30 read with Part A of Para A clause 15 (b) of Schedule III of the Securities and 
Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations), 2015, as 
amended ("SEBI Listing Regulations").   
 
Dear Sir/ Madam,  
 
This is in continuation to  intimation dated August 12, 2026 and August 14, 2026 regarding   earnings 
call to discuss the unaudited financial results of the Company for the quarter ended on June 30,2026 
and pursuant to the abovementioned regulation, the audio recording of the earnings call is available 
on the Company’s website at https://belriseindustries.com.  
 
You may also Click Here to directly access the audio link.  
 
This submission is also being made available on the Company’s website under the tab ‘Investor 
Relations’ at https://belriseindustries.com. 
 
You are requested to take the above on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Belrise Industries Limited
